properties.description: Chinese cuisine is marked by an emphasis on freshness, flavor, and a balance of tastes. The cuisine is incredibly diverse, with flavors and ingredients varying greatly from region to region. Chinese dishes often incorporate a variety of ingredients and cooking methods, and they're known for their depth of flavor and complexity.
properties.history: Chinese cuisine has a rich history dating back to the Shang Dynasty (1600–1046 BC). However, the 'Four Great Traditions' that are often recognized in Chinese cuisine today, can be traced back to the regions of Canton, Huaiyang, Shandong, and Szechuan.
properties.presentation_style: Served family style with communal dishes

properties.description: Chinese traditional music is a rich fusion of numerous regional folk music, together with music from neighbouring regions. It often employs a pentatonic scale and is performed with a variety of Chinese traditional instruments.
properties.history: Chinese traditional music dates back to the dawn of Chinese civilization and has long been a vital part of Chinese culture. Instruments found in China have an almost 8000-year-old history, while the oldest written sources date from 2000 BC.
properties.performance: Can be performed solo, but duet or ensemble performances are also common
properties.rhythm: Varies, complex rhythmic structures are not uncommon
properties.tempo: Varies, depending on the genre and region
properties.vocals: Vocals can be both clear and soothing or high-pitched and dramatic, depending on the style
